method: mass = CAD volume * effective density; COM = CAD center of volume; inertia about COM in link axes = CAD unit-mass inertia * mass. Uniform effective-density approximation, not measured print mass. Existing source inertias retained; mounting parts treated as additional mass.
assumptions: Owner accepted estimate: PETG solid material density 1250 kg/m3, effective solid volume fraction 0.5, effective density 625 kg/m3. Uniform mass distribution, not a slicer shell/infill model or measured weight. Aluminum alloy grade unknown: 6061 nominal 2700 kg/m3; unperforated 250x100x5 mm plate envelope. Fasteners omitted.
